description: The bar chart, titled "Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment," compares the runtime performance of various models in seconds. The vertical axis, labeled "Runtime (seconds)," ranges from 0 to 400 with a scale interval of 50. The horizontal axis displays five categories: "Our Joint Framework," "ChatGPT," "DeepSeek," "LLaMA," and "Claude." The legend indicates that the green bar represents "Our Joint Framework" and the light blue bars represent "LLM Models." The chart shows that "Our Joint Framework" has a runtime of 77 seconds. The LLM models have significantly higher runtimes: "ChatGPT" at 190 seconds, "DeepSeek" at 365 seconds, "LLaMA" at 172 seconds, and "Claude" at 243 seconds. The bars are arranged in descending order of runtime from left to right, with "DeepSeek" having the longest runtime and "Our Joint Framework" the shortest.
